entry.title: Town Hall Tower (Kraków)
entry.note: The exact mapped principal wall axis is directed so the plain entrance and lion stairway face north-north-east, matching the registry description and site photographs. The base shaft is slightly inset from projecting stonework in the mapped outline. The documented 55 cm lean has no defensible compass vector in the cited evidence and is not arbitrarily assigned. The source does not treat the demolished adjoining town hall as a present building. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
